name: Mohammed bin Salman Al Saud (MBS)
position: Crown Prince and Prime Minister of Saudi Arabia
ideology: Saudi cultural nationalism, modernization, economic diversification (Vision 2030), pragmatic non-alignment
period_active: Crown Prince since June 2017; appointed Prime Minister September 2022
foreign_policy_position: Multi-aligned strategic autonomy; leader of OPEC+ oil diplomacy alongside Russia; restoration of ties with Iran under Chinese mediation; conditioning Israeli normalization on Palestinian statehood; pursuing civilian nuclear cooperation and defense pact with the United States.
current_status: In office as Prime Minister and designated heir to the throne, leading supreme executive and economic decision-making across all sectors.
